snippet.title: Eldritch Horror Digital Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Asmodee Entertainment and Cornerstone Software Development, Inc. proudly invite investigators, mercenaries, cultists and private eyes the world over to relive an adventure like no other! The award-winning board game, Eldritch Horror, has lovingly been brought to life in digital format to welcome new and old players alike. Featuring the beloved characters and mechanics, faithfully adapted to a new medium, the digital edition of Eldritch Horror also enhances the experience with voiced dialogue, faster gameplay and music dripping in 1920s occult aesthetic.

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4089610/Eldritch_Horror_Digital_Edition/
